items.title: Iran agreed to give up enriched uranium in US deal, officials say

featured_image.name: Top Iranian official says Tehran would forgo highly enriched uranium in nuclear  deal with Trump

items.description: Two US officials told the New York Times that Iran has agreed in broad terms to give up its stockpile of highly enriched uranium as part of a framework deal announced by President Donald Trump, who declared Saturday that a peace agreement had been "largely negotiated." But a senior Iranian source subsequently told Reuters that Tehran has not agreed to hand over its enriched uranium, highlighting the persistent contradictions between American and Iranian accounts of the deal's terms.[1][2][3][4]

items.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated,' Strait of Hormuz to reopen

featured_image.name: Trump gives Iran 48-hour deadline to reopen Strait of Hormuz or face new  strikes

items.description: President Donald Trump declared Saturday that a memorandum of understanding with Iran has been "largely negotiated," with final details to be announced shortly, marking the most concrete step yet toward ending months of conflict between the two nations.

items.title: Trump tells negotiators not to rush Iran deal

featured_image.name: LIVE: Trump instructs negotiators 'not to rush into a deal' with Iran

items.description:
President Donald Trump said on Sunday that he has instructed his negotiators not to "rush into a deal" with Iran, declaring that the U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports will "remain in full force and effect" until a final agreement is "reached, certified, and signed."[1][2][3]

The statement came just a day after Trump posted on Truth Social that a memorandum of understanding to end the months-long conflict had been "largely negotiated," raising expectations for an imminent breakthrough.[3][4]

items.description: The Ebola outbreak tearing through eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, with the disease now spreading across borders into Uganda and prompting emergency declarations from global health authorities.

items.title: Russia fires Oreshnik missile in massive assault on Kyiv

featured_image.name: Russia launched Oreshnik missile at Kyiv Oblast in overnight attack ...

items.description:
Russia unleashed one of its most devastating aerial assaults on Kyiv since the full-scale invasion began, firing 90 missiles and 600 drones at the Ukrainian capital and surrounding areas overnight Sunday, killing at least four people and wounding more than 80, according to Ukrainian officials.[1][2]

Multiple rounds of explosions were heard across the city throughout the early morning hours in a bombardment that lasted more than five hours, damaging residential buildings, schools, markets, and a trade center across the capital.[3][4]

items.title: Zelensky calls Germany's associate EU membership plan 'unfair'

featured_image.name: Exclusive-Ukraine's Zelenskiy says proposal of associate EU ...

items.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky told EU leaders in a letter sent late on Friday that a German proposal to grant Ukraine "associate" membership of the European Union was "unfair" because it would leave Kyiv without a voice inside the bloc, according to Reuters, which reviewed the message.[1][2]

"It would be unfair for Ukraine to be present in the European Union, but remain voiceless," Zelensky wrote. "The time is right to move forward with Ukraine's membership in a full and meaningful way."[2][1]

items.description: Taiwan's National Security Council chief Joseph Wu said Saturday that China has deployed more than 100 navy, coast guard, and other vessels across regional waters in what marks one of Beijing's largest maritime shows of force in recent memory, raising alarm over China's intentions toward the self-governing island.[1][2][3]
